name: chatsystem
description: Root orchestrator for Chat System microservices

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend/api-gateway && npm install --prefix backend/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/user-service && npm install --prefix backend/group-service && npm install --prefix backend/chat-service && npm install --prefix backend/activity-service && npm install --prefix backend/status-service && npm install --prefix backend/analytics-service
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgWhite.bold,bgGray.bold" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,GROUP,CHAT,ACTIVITY,STATUS,ANALYTICS" "npm run dev --prefix backend/api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix backend/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/user-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/group-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/chat-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/activity-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/status-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/analytics-service"
